title: Oscar and the Scholarship
author: Xanthe Lockridge
blurb: Marguerite Vasquez, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
